user.title: Connect to SmartRace
user.description: Start the Connect Server in SmartRace, then enter its address and port. Commands are sent directly over your local network.

reconfigure.title: Update SmartRace connection
reconfigure.description: Change the server address or port. The new connection is checked before saving. Your existing buttons and automations are retained.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the address, port, network access, and that SmartRace Connect Server is running.
error.invalid_host: Enter only an IPv4 address or hostname, without ws://, a port, or a path.
error.already_configured: This address and port are already used by another SmartRace entry.

abort.already_configured: This SmartRace server is already configured.
